Meet Helen

Hello, I'm Helenand this is my studio.

I'm a personal trainer and yoga teacher, and I run Heat Fitness with a lovely team of teachers, upstairs and downstairs.

I've worked here since the studio opened, teaching various classes, and now I've been lucky enough to take on the business. It's my absolute pleasure to be here. I want to create a space with something for everybody, whether that's super slow yoga on the floor, a sweaty hot class or a strength session downstairs.

What keeps me going is watching people change. I've seen someone who couldn't touch their toes end up with their leg in the air. I've seen someone who couldn't lie still for a minute tell me the rest at the end is now their favourite bit.

I'm a big believer in not forcing things on people. I'd much rather work with what you can do and what you want to do. Everything I'm doing here is for you, so tell me what you'd like and I'll do my best to make it happen.

We're Stirling's only hot yoga studio, but not every class is hot. Downstairs there's a small gym where I teach strength. Upstairs there's the studio for yoga, hot and cool.

Pop in for a cup of tea first. No pressure, and no sales pitch.

Qualifications

  • Level 3 Personal Trainer
  • Level 2 Certificate in Fitness Instructing
  • 200-hour yoga teacher training, and around 700 classes taught
  • Menopause coach
  • TRX suspension training, Metafit and aqua fitness instructor
  • First aid trained
  • Training as a breathwork coach
